metadata.protocol: Expanding rolling origins. Target-year folds. Fixed hyperparameters; 2017 development only; all methods on paired common support within each scenario/source experiment. COVID flag 2020-2021; no deletion of those years.
metadata.intervals: 80% absolute-residual conformal radius with finite-sample rank; at least 20 matured out-of-sample targets by origin. No coverage guarantee under drift.
metadata.threshold: 90th percentile of previous-year cases within ±2 ordinal calendar weeks of target; at least 5 observations, past data only. Research threshold, not a DOH outbreak declaration.
metadata.mase: Absolute error scaled by mean one-step naive error on known adjacent calendar weeks in each training prefix.
metadata.bootstrap: Paired moving blocks of 8 observed targets, circular sampling, 400 replicates, 95% percentile interval; gaps mean blocks are not always eight calendar weeks. Exploratory uncertainty, not a powered clinical comparison.
metadata.weather: Assume a minimum 7-day lag after the end of each weather week (provider documents ~5-day delay). Reanalysis revisions can use information unavailable historically; retrospective sensitivity, not validated operational weather skill.
metadata.ridge: Training-only standardization, fixed L2=20, log1p target, no lognormal bias correction, >=32 training examples. Rain uses log1p(mm); temperature Celsius; humidity percent; lags 1-8 before origin; case lags 0-3 and annual harmonics + COVID indicator.
metadata.tree: 24 gradient-boosted stumps, learning rate .05, minimum leaf 16, 7 training-only quantile split candidates, L2 leaf=10, log1p target. Fixed, no tuning on test folds.
limitations: Retrospective reanalysis is not real-time vintage data
Sparse alert events can make AUC/precision undefined
Probability of rise and alerts use empirical past residuals, not a separately validated clinical classifier
Mean lead is correct-positive forecast horizon, not episode-based outbreak lead time
Deaths anomalies flagged and excluded in DOH case training under existing policy
No deep learning: fewer than 500 weekly observations per scenario
No current 2026 surveillance; all forecasts historical

selection.rule: Simplest within 5% of best mean 1/2-week MAE in 2017 development; weather excluded from operational selection because vintage availability is unverified. 2018-2023 held out.
